title: Public testnet RPC is slow (several seconds per call)
summary: The public testnet RPC answered in 3.7 to 4.8 seconds per query. A short client timeout looks like a logic failure rather than a slow node.
message: Median RPC latency to {url} was {ms} ms.

steps: Use client timeouts of at least {recommended} ms for public RPC calls.
For anything user-facing, use a dedicated or failover RPC provider: https://docs.near.org/api/rpc/providers
fix.agent: Raise RPC client timeouts to at least {recommended} ms and issue independent reads in parallel.

evidence.observed: Measured 2026-11-13: curl timings of 3.7 s and 4.8 s for two queries against https://rpc.testnet.near.org, and an 8 s timeout on RPC reads failed in a scorer service. Latency varies with time and location; run `near-doctor --net` to measure yours.
